senses.gloss: m. (פָּצַץ to split) mat of reeds, bark &c.; the poor man’s mattress.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 113b">B. Mets. 113ᵇ</cite> in cases of seizure for debt we must allow <he>מיטה ומיטה ומ׳ וכ׳</he> a (dining) couch and a couch with matting to the poor man, contrad. to <cite ref="M02342"><he>מַצָּע</he></cite>.
